title: Amadera no goke: Yobai tokomakura
original_title: 尼寺の後家　夜這い床枕
overview: In a peaceful rural town, the nun Myoshin of the nunnery Taiseizan Mankoji is sleeping in her room. Suddenly, someone breaks in and attacks Myoshin. Myoshin notices the intruder and tries to resist, but soon she succumbs to the stranger's caresses…
